patthana12.20:1.1: pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na dassanena pahātabba hetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na na dassanena pahātabba hetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na bhāvanāyapahātabba hetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.20:2.1: na saraṇaṃ na na bhāvanāya pahātabba hetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.20:3.1: na saraṇaṃ na savitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na avitakkaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na savicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.20:4.1: na saraṇaṃ na avicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.20:5.1: na saraṇaṃ na sappītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na appītikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na na pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na na sukhasagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.20:7.1: na saraṇaṃ na na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.20:8.1: na saraṇaṃ na kāmāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na
patthana12.20:10.1: na na rūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na arūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na na arūpāvacaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na pariyāpannaṃ
patthana12.20:12.1: apariyāpannaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na
patthana12.20:13.1: niyyānikaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na aniyyānikaṃ
patthana12.20:14.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na niyataṃ
patthana12.20:16.1: aniyataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na sauttaraṃ
patthana12.20:18.1: na saraṇaṃ na sauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana12.20:19.1: na saraṇaṃ na anuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇo na anuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana12.20:20.1: ekaṃ, na araṇaṃ na anuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na araṇo na anuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na araṇaṃ na anuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na anuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na araṇaṃ na anuttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na anuttaro ca na araṇo na anuttaro ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana12.20:21.1: na saraṇaṃ na anuttarañca na araṇaṃ na anuttarañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na anuttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana12.20:22.1: hetuyā pañca, (sabbattha vitthāretabbaṃ sahajātavārampi paccayavārampi nissayavārampi saṃsaṭṭhavārampi sampayuttavārampi pañhāvārampi vitthāretabbaṃ.)
